title: Common LOINC Lab Codes

purpose:
(Clinical Focus: This set of values encompasses LOINC's list of codes most commonly used for lab tests.),(Data Element Scope: LOINC codes derived from CommonLabResult:true via Search LOINC. The intended use of this set is to help in the definition and implementation of exchange standards related to lab tests.),(Inclusion Criteria: LOINC codes in derived from CommonLabResult:true via seach LOINC limited to active and trial statuses.
